title: Hey Kevin voice bakeoff environment reconciliation Phase 0.5 v4

rules: Every operator fixture uses only this vocabulary.
dominant_status is the first value present in dominant_display_precedence.
execution_not_authorized remains dominant during every read-only phase.
A phase receipt may change inventory evidence only.
Governance remains undecided unless a separate owner decision changes it.
The default disposition while incomplete or undecided is retain_frozen.

derivation: load the exact V2 read_contract.methods bound by v2_json_sha256
remove each method named by V3 method_overrides.replaces_v2_method_ref
insert every exact V3 method_overrides entry under its V3 method ref
insert every exact V3 method_additions entry under its V3 method ref
RFC8785-canonicalize the resulting key-sorted object and verify composite_method_table_sha256

sequence_rules: phase ordinal one binds predecessor_phase_receipt_digest to GENESIS and cumulative_prior_request_count to zero.
phase ordinal one binds predecessor_parameter_allowlist_digest to GENESIS; every later phase binds the exact payload-safe allowlist digest derived by its authenticated predecessor.
Every later phase binds the immediately preceding authenticated phase receipt digest.
phase_ordinal and phase exactly match the six-entry phase contract.
cumulative_request_count equals cumulative_prior_request_count plus request_count and never exceeds 592.
The session ledger accepts at most one owner-signed envelope and one phase receipt per inventory_session_id plus phase_ordinal.
The phase-once ledger entry is consumed before the first request and survives denied partial malformed or failed responses.
Every request nonce is derived from inventory_session_id phase_ordinal envelope_nonce_seed request index and canonical request digest.
A phase cannot start until the predecessor receipt passes semantic signature freshness completeness and phase-once checks.
Any mismatch stale value skipped ordinal duplicate phase or unavailable predecessor yields incomplete before dispatch.
inventory_session_contract.request_nonce_rule: sha256(domain_separator || inventory_session_id || uint32_be(phase_ordinal) || envelope_nonce_seed || uint32_be(request_index) || canonical_request_digest)
